BasicPaneUtils.luau.description: Basic Pane Utils provides the class/model implementation used by the Basicpaneutils package. Public entry points include `BasicPaneUtils.observeVisible`, `BasicPaneUtils.whenVisibleBrio`, `ensurePane`, `BasicPaneUtils.observePercentVisible`, `BasicPaneUtils.observeShow`.
